subject: reasoning
question: Three of the four group of words are alike in some manner. Select the odd group of words.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Option 1) (Car, Truck, Road) → Here, Car and Truck are types of vehicles, and Road is where these vehicles are used.**

Option 2) (Chair, Table, Stool) → All three are types of furniture. They all belong to the same category.

Option 3) (Choreographer, Editor, Carpenter) → These are all professional roles or jobs. They all belong to the same category.

Option 4) (Shirt, Trouser, Saree) → These are all types of clothing. They all belong to the same category.

So, 'Option 1' odd among the options.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
